description: This file contains a custom Unity MonoBehaviour class 'DefaultInitializationErrorHandler' that handles Vuforia SDK initialization errors and displays GUI messages accordingly.

classes.name: DefaultInitializationErrorHandler
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that registers for Vuforia SDK initialization errors, handles error display via GUI, and manages callback registration.

methods.name: OnVuforiaInitializationError
methods.description: Handles Vuforia initialization errors when they occur and sets error state info.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Registers the error callback with Vuforia runtime on object awake.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initial setup of GUI styles when the object starts.

methods.name: OnGUI
methods.description: Displays full-screen error window if an error has occurred.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the error callback when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: DrawWindowContent
methods.description: Draws the error message window with header, message, and close button.

methods.name: SetErrorCode
methods.description: Sets corresponding error message text based on the specific Vuforia error code.

methods.name: getKeyInfo
methods.description: Generates a string with information about the current Vuforia license key.

methods.name: SetupGUIStyles
methods.description: Configures GUI styles and textures for the error display UI.

methods.name: CreateSinglePixelTexture
methods.description: Creates a 1x1 pixel Texture2D with specified color for GUI backgrounds.
